# data/ — PS4 EN→DE parallel data (generated by A_D_member1.ipynb)

Source: News Commentary EN–DE (WMT training data), loaded from the Hugging Face hub
`Helsinki-NLP/news_commentary` (config `de-en`, 223,153 pairs); also distributed via OPUS
(https://opus.nlpl.eu/datasets/News-Commentary). Licence: see the OPUS/WMT corpus page (research use).
Citation: J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS, LREC.

Pipeline: NFC + whitespace normalization; drop empty / letter-less / untranslated pairs; dedupe English side;
seeded pool of 40,000; ASCII quotes/dashes; Moses tokenizer (sacremoses, en/de, escape=False);
lowercase; keep 1-30 tokens per side and length ratio <= 2.0; seed 42.

| file | lines | content |
|---|---|---|
| train.tok.en / train.tok.de | 10,000 | tokenized, lowercased training pairs |
| test.tok.en / test.tok.de | 500 | held-out pairs, same preprocessing |
| test.raw.en / test.raw.de | 500 | same test pairs, original casing, untokenized (NMT input, sacreBLEU refs) |
| lm_heldout.tok.de | 500 | German-only held-out sentences for LM perplexity |
| eval_set.csv | see file | 15-sentence evaluation set (id, category, en, de_ref, source) |
| stress_set.csv | see file | robustness stress set (id, phenomenon, en, de_ref, news_focus) |
